text:
Maria CSM: Quick heads up — prepping the QBR slide pack for Helix (renewal ~45 days). Draft is here: https://redwood.slides/helix-qbr-draft :point_right:
Jake CSM: Saw it, thanks Maria. I updated the adoption slide with last 30d MAU numbers.
Sophie Solutions: Noted a couple onboarding gaps: workspace invites lagging, two integrations not fully configured, and doc-driven flows not adopted. I'll drop a 1-slide gap summary.
Priya AM: Renewal risk flagging — payment contact changed last week, and NPS trended down from 9 to 6 after the incident. Recommend a 1:1 with exec sponsor and a focused enablement runbook.
Maria CSM: Good call. Who can own the exec 3-slide "ask" (value, requested support, timeline)? We should keep it laser: 1) extension, 2) co-marketing intro, 3) dedicated onboarding SOW.
Jake CSM: I can draft the ask slide and include a short ROI blurb.
Alan Eng: I can do a 2-min demo GIF of the new onboarding dashboard (performance + user journeys) to put in the pack. Will need the account id to anonymize.
Sophie Solutions: I'll add the enablement plan with concrete dates: kickoff workshop, integration sprint, weekly office hours for 4 weeks.
Priya AM: For the 1:1, suggest week of 1891238400 (Mon). Who from exec should join? Recommend Maria + Head of CS + Customer Success Director.
Maria CSM: Agreed. I'll request the exec slot. Also capturing feedback asks: can we get product to prioritize the integrations issue (label: helix-integ) for a P1 fix?
Alan Eng: tagging backlog owner. I can push a hotfix candidate for the connector — ETA 7 days if we freeze scope.
OpsBot: Meeting scheduled: QBR dry run — 1891238400 (Mon) 1400-1430 PT. Organizer: Maria CSM.
Jake CSM: Action items I have: draft exec-ask slide, add ROI numbers, sync with Alan for GIF.
Sophie Solutions: Action items: onboarding gap slide, enablement schedule, own office hours cadences.
Priya AM: Action items: book sponsor 1:1, draft renewal mitigation plan, compile open risks for the exec readout.
Maria CSM: I'll collate slides and send final deck by Fri 1800 PT. Please add any high-priority notes as comments on the slide link. :memo:
Alan Eng: Quick note — include this snippet in the notes for the demo so execs know it's non-prod: 
```
Demo: onboarding-dashboard (anon) -> shows funnel, avg time to first successful api call, top 3 errors
```
Jake CSM: Got it. Will add to speaker notes.
Sophie Solutions: One ask — can CX ops pull a list of customers in similar segments with integration gaps? Would be useful to show as bench-marking.
Priya AM: I'll confirm sponsor availability today and post update.
Maria CSM: Thanks team. If no other blockers, we go into dry-run with this deck and roles assigned. :rocket:
